nodes.description: Mapping address=>bool tracking accounts allowed to mint/burn; checked by the onlyController modifier.
uint256 public cap on total token supply, initialized to 40000000000 ether and updatable by the owner.
Public initializer that sets token metadata, pausable/ownable/UUPS state and the initial maxSupply value.
Controller-only function that checks amount + totalSupply() against maxSupply and mints new tokens via _mint.
Controller-only function that destroys tokens from an arbitrary account via _burn.
Owner-only function that pauses all token transfers (_pause).
Owner-only function that resumes token transfers (_unpause).
Owner-only function that overwrites the maxSupply state variable with an arbitrary new value.
Owner-only function that grants mint/burn rights by setting controllers[controller] = true.
Owner-only function that revokes mint/burn rights by setting controllers[controller] = false.
Pausable transfer hook override called before every mint, burn and transfer.
UUPS upgrade authorization hook restricted with onlyOwner, gating the proxy upgrade path.
Caller-controlled address used by the onlyController and onlyOwner modifiers to gate privileged functions.
Arithmetic expression amount + totalSupply() inside mint used for the max supply comparison.
Low-level delegatecall executed during the UUPS upgrade flow (_functionDelegateCall) that runs arbitrary new implementation code in the proxy context.
Recipient address parameter of mint.
Mint amount parameter of mint, fed into the supply arithmetic.
Account parameter of burn whose balance is destroyed.
Amount parameter of burn.
New supply cap parameter of setMaxSupply.
Address parameter of addController.
Address parameter of removeController.
Address parameter of _authorizeUpgrade denoting the new implementation.

edges.reason: mint is guarded by onlyController which requires controllers[msg.sender], so the caller address controls execution.
burn is guarded by onlyController which validates controllers[msg.sender].
pause is guarded by onlyOwner comparing owner() with _msgSender().
unpause is guarded by onlyOwner comparing owner() with _msgSender().
setMaxSupply is owner-gated via the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
addController is owner-gated via the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
removeController is owner-gated via the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
_authorizeUpgrade is restricted with onlyOwner, so the caller determines whether a proxy upgrade proceeds.
initialize sets the owner (via __Ownable_init) to msg.sender, so the caller gains privileged ownership.
controllers mapping value decides whether mint may proceed for the caller.
controllers mapping value decides whether burn may proceed for the caller.
addController writes true into the controllers mapping.
removeController writes false into the controllers mapping.
maxSupply is read by mint to bound the total token amount.
maxSupply is read in setMaxSupply before being overwritten.
setMaxSupply assigns the maxSupply_ argument into the maxSupply state variable.
initialize writes the initial 40000000000 ether value into maxSupply.
the amount argument feeds the amount + totalSupply() arithmetic that must not overflow the supply cap.
the computed amount + totalSupply() sum is the require condition inside mint.
the to argument is passed through to _mint inside mint.
the amount argument is passed through to _mint inside mint.
the from argument is passed to _burn inside burn.
the amount argument is passed to _burn inside burn.
the maxSupply_ argument is stored into the maxSupply state variable.
the controller argument is used as the key set to true in the controllers mapping.
the controller argument is used as the key set to false in the controllers mapping.
the newImplementation argument is received by the _authorizeUpgrade hook.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook, an external-controllable callback point before state finalization.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are updated.
after _authorizeUpgrade passes, the upgrade flow reaches the low-level delegatecall to the new implementation.
the delegatecall into the new implementation can re-enter the upgrade/proxy logic before upgrade state is finalized.

normalization_plan.reason: to is only a mint argument forwarded to _mint and has no meaning outside that function.
amount is the input of the mint supply arithmetic expression and should be folded into that unsafe operation.
from is only the burn target and carries no independent semantics.
burnAmount is only consumed by burn when calling _burn.
maxSupply_ is purely the incoming value assigned to the maxSupply state variable inside setMaxSupply.
controller_add is only used as the mapping key written to true in addController.
controller_remove is only used as the mapping key written to false in removeController.
newImplementation is only received by the upgrade authorization hook and has no other use.
